title: Allama Iqbal Open University Amendment Ordinance 1984

sections.shortTitle: Allama Iqbal Open University Amendment Ordinance 1984
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXIII OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXIII OF 1984
ALLAMA IQBAL OPEN UNIVERSITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the
Allama Iqbal Open University Act, 1974
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th May, 1984]
No. F. 17(1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Allama Iqbal Open University (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Allama Iqbal Open University Amendment Ordinance 1984
sections.description:
Amendment of section 31, Act XXXIX of 1974

ORDINANCE XXIII OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXIII OF 1984
ALLAMA IQBAL OPEN UNIVERSITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the
Allama Iqbal Open University Act, 1974
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th May, 1984]
No. F. 17(1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information.
2. Amendment of section 31, Act XXXIX of 1974.--In the Allama Iqbal
Open University Act, 1974 (XXXIX of 1974), in section 31, after subsec tion
(2), the following new subsection shall be added, namely :-
"(3) No order on an appeal or application for review
shall be passed without affording to the appellant or applicant, as the case
may be, an opportunity of being heard.".
